title: Unmounting a drive or network volume permanently erases every Shelf card on it
evidence: ShelfStore.swift:238-245 isGone() returns true for NSFileReadNoSuchFileError, which a path under an unmounted /Volumes/X returns; refreshFromDisk (:180-205) removes those cards and persist()s; bookmarks resolve with .withoutMounting (:149-153) so they fall back to the bare path.
fix: Treat a card whose volume root is not mounted as offline (keep, dim), evict only when the volume is present and the file missing; add a ShelfStoreTests case for a nonexistent /Volumes root.

title: Translate privacy cover hides the source but shows the translation in full
evidence: TranslatePane.swift:26-27 covered = privacy.hides(.translate,'translate.source'); result()/outcome() (:133-183) render translator.output with no privacy check. ⌃⌥⌘T fills the source from the clipboard.
fix: Cover the output column with the same SpoilerField under the same reveal id; one reveal uncovers both.

title: Lock card text drops to about 1.6-2.4:1 over a pale album cover
evidence: LockScreenCard.swift:209-235 coverLight: cover blurred, saturation 1.3, black 0.34 (0.2 in Transparent at layer opacity 0.62), bottom gradient to 0.22. Card tokens: cardSecondary 0.62, cardTertiary 0.50 (Theme.swift:385-394). Near-white cover: backdrop about 168 grey, white 2.4:1, cardSecondary about 1.8:1, cardTertiary about 1.6:1. Comment claims it is 'dimmed so white type holds over the palest one'. ContrastRampTests measure against black only.
fix: Raise the wash to a floor that holds 4.5:1 for cardSecondary over a white source (or scale it by measured cover luminance), and extend ContrastRampTests to compute against the brightest permitted backdrop.

title: Escape does nothing on a panel opened from the keyboard outside Translate, and Command-Tab leaves it up
evidence: NotchPanel.swift:28 canBecomeKey == acceptsKeyboard (false unless a typing tab asked); Escape is read only in sendEvent (:81-95), which needs key status. NotchController.swift:661-665 and :875-879 promise 'Escape folds the panel from any tab'. Pinned opens (toggle() :666-695, Show Isla intent, toggleLyrics) end only on the same hot key or a click in another app (global monitor :734-759); no didActivateApplication observer.
fix: While pinned, register a transient Escape hot key (Carbon, no permission) or make the pinned panel key; close a pinned panel on NSWorkspace.didActivateApplicationNotification.

title: VoiceOver reads every clipboard row as 'Copy Entry' and cannot remove or reveal one
evidence: ClipboardPane.swift:111-117 .accessibilityElement(children: .combine) then .accessibilityLabel('Copy Entry') replaces the combined text; Remove (:77-94) and the reveal eye exist only on hover and carry no accessibility action.
fix: Label with the preview (or 'Hidden' when covered), keep Copy as the default action, add named actions Remove and Reveal.

title: Shelf cards expose no accessibility element, label or action
evidence: ShelfPane.swift: the only accessibility modifier is on the hover-only remove button (:208); select/open/drag live in the ShelfDragSource NSView overlay (ShelfDragSource.swift:32-103) with no accessibility overrides; Quick Look, AirDrop, Copy, Show in Finder only in contextMenu (:213-221).
fix: Make each card one element (label name, value age plus selection, isSelected trait) with actions Open, Quick Look, AirDrop, Copy, Show in Finder, Remove independent of hover.

title: Lyrics say 'Lyrics are off.' and offer a dead 'Show Lyrics' button for any track with no length
evidence: LyricsCoordinator.swift:221 guard ... duration > 0 else availability = .disabled; LyricsPresentation.swift:19-21 maps .disabled to 'Lyrics are off.' and :54-55 to Offer.turnOnLyrics; NotchViewModel.swift:383-386 turnOnLyrics only rewrites the already-true key and refreshVisibility hits the same guard. MediaPane compactLyricsStatus shows the caption unconditionally.
fix: Add an availability for 'cannot look up' (no duration) with honest copy and no offer; never map it to .disabled.

title: Hide from Screen Recording relies only on sharingType = .none, which may not exclude the panel from ScreenCaptureKit on macOS 15+
evidence: NotchPanel.swift:163-168 is the whole mechanism; default on with the justification 'a password read out to a meeting' (NotchViewModel.swift:894-905); the lock card is also a NotchPanel.
fix: Test on macOS 26.6 and 27 with QuickTime and a ScreenCaptureKit app; if it leaks, reword the setting and stop promising, or auto-cover Clipboard/Translate while a capture is detected.

title: Compressed LRC (several timestamps on one line) is rejected as invalid, locally and from LRCLIB
evidence: LocalLyricsDocument.swift:89-94 compares each timestamp to the previous one across lines and throws invalidTimestamp, so '[00:10][01:30]Chorus' then '[00:20]Verse' fails. OnlineLyrics.swift:99,227 parse LRCLIB synced text with try?, so the same file is silently a miss. Caption becomes 'No lyrics for this track.' with no reason.
fix: Collect all (timestamp, text) pairs, stable-sort, then validate; surface the parse failure reason in the stage.

title: Lyric stage keys rows and scroll position by timestamp, so equal timestamps share one id
evidence: LyricsStage.swift:244 ForEach(..., id: \.element.at), :247 .id(line.at), :254 scrollPosition(id:), :284 reading = lines[anchor].at. Parser accepts equal stamps (strict < check) and multi-stamp lines; cleaned() does not dedupe.
fix: Key rows and scrollPosition by index (or an id minted at parse), or merge same-time lines into one two-row line.

title: Karaoke sweep animates over 0.25 s while the clock ticks every 0.1 s, so the lit edge trails the voice
evidence: KaraokeText.swift:108 .linear(duration: 0.25) with the comment 'one tick of the position ticker'; MediaController.swift:330 positionTickInterval = 0.1. Each tick retargets before the last finishes; steady-state gap about 2.5 ticks of motion. Sync gate (MotionValuesTests) measures the clock, not the drawn edge; comments in KaraokeText, LyricsStage:321 and KaraokeTextTests still describe the 4 Hz ticker.
fix: Use .linear(duration: MediaController.positionTickInterval) or drive the edge from TimelineView; assert duration <\= tick in a test; re-run Scripts/measure-sync.sh since the 0.20 s lead may have been calibrated against the old lag.

title: Lock card with no cover uses system glassEffect above the shield, contradicting the checklist's 'drawn recipe' record
evidence: LockScreenCard.swift:149-163 passes samplesBackdrop: style != .solid && media.artwork == nil and no preferDrawn; GlassSurface.swift usesSystemGlass then returns true on macOS 26. checklist.md (Lock-screen card entry) says 'no window above it is given a backdrop to blur, so the glass is a drawn recipe'. NotchViewModel.swift:840-851 calls the question unsettled.
fix: Check on a locked macOS 26 Mac; if it reads wrong pass preferDrawn: true for the card and raise the drawn trailing base; then make code and checklist agree.

title: Nothing is ever announced to VoiceOver: peeks, charger/headphones moments, lock-card track change, armed confirmations, copy ticks, locked-island refusal
evidence: No NSAccessibility.post / AccessibilityNotification / announcement in Sources (grep). Peek and ambient last 2.2 s (NotchController.swift:1320,1367); compact island VoiceOver action silently returns while locked (NotchContentView.swift:580-583); ConfirmTextButton arms with no announcement (Confirmation.swift:64-87); CopyButton label stays 'Copy'.
fix: One small Announcer helper posting announcementRequested for ambient label, new title, 'Press again to clear', 'Copied', 'Unlock to open'; rate-limit like the peek.

title: Several controls have hit regions under 20 pt: swap 18x14, text buttons Clear/Deselect/remedies, 14 pt scrubber strip, 14 pt language-menu row
evidence: TranslatePane.swift:313 frame(18,14); :370 column header row height 14; Confirmation.swift:77-82 caption Text label with no frame or contentShape (Clear in ShelfPane.swift:107, ClipboardPane.swift:45); ShelfPane.swift:102-105 Deselect same; MediaPane.swift:365 and LockScreenCard.swift:657 scrub strip height 14.
fix: Give PanelButtonStyle a minimum hit frame with contentShape (about 24x20), grow the scrub strip to 22 pt with the same drawn bar.

title: Media clock ticks 10 Hz on every tab and on the lock card, and every MediaController observer (SettingsPane included) re-evaluates on each tick
evidence: NotchController.swift:1177 setActive(true) on every open regardless of tab; MediaController.swift:2065-2079 ticker gated on isPlaying && isActive only; position is @Published (:21) and tick() writes it every 0.1 s; SettingsPane.swift:12 @ObservedObject media but reads only fallbackReason (:240). Precision AppleScript poll (1 Hz) gated on the Settings switch, not a visible lyric surface (:698,714).
fix: Split position/label into a small PlaybackClock observed only by scrubber, caption and lyric views; run the ticker only when the music pane or a lyric surface is visible; gate the precision poll on a visible lyric surface.

title: Clipboard tab runs a 20 Hz TimelineView even when no row is covered
evidence: ClipboardPane.swift:27 wraps the list in SpoilerClock unconditionally; SpoilerClock.swift:19 TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1/20)) whenever Reduce Motion is off. Privacy covers default off.
fix: Pass an active flag (privacy.covers(.clipboard) and any visible row hidden) and render content directly otherwise.

title: Tab switch keeps its 0.97/1.02 scale under Reduce Motion
evidence: NotchContentView.swift:848-857 builds .opacity.combined(with: .scale(...)) inline instead of Theme.scaleIn(_:reduceMotion:) (Theme.swift:134), which exists for exactly this.
fix: Use opacity only when reduceMotion; add a test beside MotionValuesTests.

title: Locked-island refusal shake probably never plays, and cannot replay on a second click
evidence: The locked branch carries .transaction { $0.animation = nil } (NotchContentView.swift:139-140) above lockedPill, whose .refusalShake (:200) plays via withAnimation in RefusalShake.swift:33; only implicit .animation declared beneath survives, per the file's own comment. Separately RefusalShake.swift:32-33 writes progress = 0 then animates to 1 in one pass, so from a resting 1 there is no net change to animate; ShakeOffset returns identity at progress 1 (:51).
fix: Drive the shake with keyframeAnimator(trigger:) or a phase toggle, and verify under the nil transaction on a locked Mac.

title: Mail/Photos drops are trashed after seven days while the Shelf still shows their card
evidence: NotchStores.swift:80 runs AppPaths.pruneDropInbox() every launch; AppPaths.swift:62-72 trashes Dropped/<uuid> folders older than 7 days by modification date, with no check against live shelf cards; refreshFromDisk then drops the card (isInTrash).
fix: Pass the shelf's live URLs to the prune and skip referenced folders.

title: Dragging a card out offers Move; Finder moves the original and the card keeps a dead path
evidence: ShelfDragSource.swift:89-93 source mask [.copy,.move,.link,.generic] outside the app; draggingSession(_:endedAt:operation:) (:95-102) ignores the operation; the store refreshes only on Shelf entry.
fix: On a .move result re-resolve the dragged URLs through their bookmarks or remove them; whether Move should be offered at all is an owner decision (see decisions).

title: With the Translate cover on, the field goes invisible on the first typed character
evidence: TranslatePane.swift:24-27 covered = hides(...) && !translator.input.isEmpty; the TextEditor gets .opacity(covered ? 0 : 1) (:92) while still focused, and the SpoilerField overlay takes the click to reveal.
fix: Do not cover while the field holds the keyboard; cover on resign.

title: Opening the Shelf does disk and network checks on the main thread and re-requests every thumbnail
evidence: ShelfStore.swift:180-205 refreshFromDisk (called on every Shelf entry) scans capture folders, calls checkResourceIsReachable per card on the main actor, then items.forEach(loadThumbnail) for all cards even if already rendered; each completion is a @Published write the whole panel observes.
fix: Move scan and reachability off main and apply once; skip thumbnails already rendered; batch completions.

title: No reopen handler and no single-instance guard
evidence: No applicationShouldHandleReopen and no NSRunningApplication bundle-id check in Sources (grep); AppDelegate.applicationDidFinishLaunching (AppDelegate.swift:18-101). Memory notes three Islas registered on 2026-09-21.
fix: applicationShouldHandleReopen opens the panel; at launch, exit if another instance with the bundle id is running.

title: 'Show Isla' and 'Show Lyrics' intents toggle, so running them on an open panel hides it
evidence: IslaIntents.swift:69 toggleLyrics(), :82 toggle(); toggleLyrics folds the page when already up (NotchController.swift:522-525); toggle() closes an open panel.
fix: Add open-only show()/showLyrics() entry points for the intents; keep toggles for hot keys.

title: AppleScript runs on one serial queue with no timeout
evidence: PlayerBridge.swift:471-501 executeAndReturnError with no 'with timeout'; grep finds none. Precision poll runs 1 Hz into Spotify while lyrics are on; shuffle/repeat/modes and track-id lookups share the queue.
fix: Wrap generated scripts in 'with timeout of 2 seconds' and map -1712 to the existing unknown reply.

title: Lock card window, AudioWatch and CoreAudio listeners are created on every lock, even with nothing playing
evidence: NotchController.swift:256-262 calls lockCard.present unconditionally; LockCardWindow.swift:94-96 starts an AudioWatch; LockScreenCard body renders nothing when media.track is nil (:124); the panel sets ignoresMouseEvents = false and LockCardRootView.hitTest (:197-203) returns super.hitTest for the whole 460x300 card rect at display centre.
fix: Present only while a track exists (and on track arrival during a lock); return nil from hitTest when there is no card content.

title: Launch at Login failure is silent; 'requires approval' snaps the switch back to off
evidence: SettingsPane.swift:631-646 logs the error and re-reads status == .enabled; .requiresApproval reads as off with no message.
fix: On .requiresApproval show a note row with a button to SMAppService.openSystemSettingsLoginItems(); other errors show the reason inline.

title: Dragging a scrubber or Settings slider past the panel edge makes the window click-through and can fold the panel mid-drag
evidence: PointerWatcher.swift:205 interactive = isDragging() || interactiveRect.contains(point); NotchController.swift:984-987 sets ignoresMouseEvents from it; isDragging (:948-950) covers file drags, shelf drags and menus only. interactiveRect has no margin; Panel Width/Hover Delay commit only on onEditingChanged(false).
fix: Latch 'button down inside the panel' from NotchPanel.sendEvent (leftMouseDown to leftMouseUp) into isDragging().

title: Lyric timing reset is a long-press with no accessibility action
evidence: LyricsStage.swift:468-478 onLongPressGesture on the offset Text with .accessibilityHint('Reset lyric timing') and no action.
fix: Add .accessibilityAction(named: 'Reset lyric timing') and a context-menu item; keep the long press for pointers.

title: Translate source field has no accessibility label or placeholder
evidence: TranslatePane.swift:91-123 TextEditor with no accessibilityLabel and no placeholder overlay.
fix: accessibilityLabel('Text to translate') plus a faint placeholder while empty (en/ru keys).

title: Lock card draws a dead seek bar at 0:00 / -0:00 when the track has no length
evidence: LockScreenCard.swift:633-660 draws the bar and labels with no duration > 0 guard (handlers just return); MediaPane.swift:180-185 deliberately hides the scrubber in the same state.
fix: Match the panel: no bar (keep spacing) when duration <= 0.

title: Lock card output picker shows only the first five devices
evidence: LockScreenCard.swift:520 ForEach(outputs.prefix(5)) with no scroll or 'more'; the current device may be outside the five.
fix: Always include the current device, cap by available height and scroll the rest.

title: Charger/headphones moment is not cleared when the panel opens, so it resurfaces on close; a second moment replaces the first
evidence: clearAmbient only at NotchController.swift:86 and :195; presentAmbient (:1332-1368) cancels ambientWork and overwrites vm.ambient; closed header shows ambientHeader whenever vm.ambient != nil (NotchContentView.swift:404-409). Timers are fixed 2.2 s with no hover pause.
fix: Clear ambient and peek on open; queue or merge a second moment; pause the fold while the pointer is on the pill.

title: Delete These Files reloads the Shelf before the background trash has run
evidence: SettingsPane.swift:221-234 calls screenshotVault.clear() then shelf.load()/refreshFromDisk()/refreshUsage() immediately; ScreenshotVault.clear() (:204-215) trashes on a utility queue with no completion. The comment 'the files were just deleted' is false at that moment.
fix: Give clear() a main-queue completion and refresh inside it.

title: Shelf silently drops cards past 60, ignores duplicate drops, and a failed file promise only logs
evidence: ShelfStore.swift:250-263 add() trims to limit with no result; duplicates skipped by URL. NotchRootView.swift:287-291 promisedFileArrived logs and returns on error; no pending card for slow promises.
fix: Return a result from add() and show one section-level notice; a pending card with progress for promises.

title: Empty Shelf shows only a glyph, with no words or accessibility label
evidence: ShelfPane.swift:73-91 dropHint is a dashed box and one SF Symbol; no Text, no label.
fix: One localized line ('Drop files here to keep them'); same for empty Clipboard.

title: Quick Look, AirDrop, Copy and Show in Finder exist only in the card context menu
evidence: ShelfPane.swift:213-221; the hover overlay has only Remove (:197-211).
fix: Show a compact action row when the selection is non-empty or on hover.

title: Shelf drag image is a generic 48 pt file icon at the view origin, not the card thumbnail under the pointer
evidence: ShelfDragSource.swift:60-68 NSWorkspace.icon(forFile:) with setDraggingFrame(NSRect(x: offset, y: -offset, 48, 48)) in the overlay's coordinates; mouseDownPoint ignored; mouseDown gives no press feedback (:42-45).
fix: Use the card thumbnail at the grab offset; show a pressed state on mouseDown.

title: Editing shortcuts in the Translate field are matched by US key position
evidence: NotchPanel.swift:45-52 and :103-115 map fixed key codes (A=0, Z=6, X=7, C=8, V=9).
fix: Prefer charactersIgnoringModifiers when it is ASCII, fall back to key codes only for non-Latin layouts.

title: Translate-clipboard hot key is silent when the clipboard has no text
evidence: AppDelegate.swift:50-51 returns when string(forType: .string) is nil.
fix: Open Translate with an inline 'The clipboard has no text' or beep as the recorder does.

title: Music artwork script has no 'if it is running' guard and can relaunch Music
evidence: PlayerBridge.swift:351-356 musicArtwork tells Music directly; the position and track-id scripts (:312-328) guard on running.
fix: Add the running check as the sibling scripts do.

title: Online translation is unbounded and all-or-nothing; Retry is offered for failures that cannot succeed
evidence: OnlineTranslation.swift:65-84 sequential 480-character requests, throws on first failure discarding the rest; Translator.swift:454-458 always sets remedies = [.retry].
fix: Cap online input with a message; keep partial results; no Retry for quota/guardrail/too-long.

title: Local lyrics folders are fully re-read and parsed on the main thread at launch and on every folder event
evidence: LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:148-160 init calls rescanFolders() (@MainActor, :50); watchers on the main queue (:575-583) schedule a full rescan after 150 ms (:588-595); no mtime check.
fix: Index by path, mtime and size off the main actor; parse lazily.

title: Artwork is decoded and held at full source resolution and fed to two large live blurs
evidence: MediaController.swift:1672-1696 NSBitmapImageRep at pixel size, no downscale (off-main, good); consumers max 118 pt; LockScreenCard.swift:210-219 scale 1.5 + blur 44; LyricsStage blur 60.
fix: Decode with CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex at about 512 px; one pre-blurred small bitmap for ambience.

title: Lock card volume drag writes CoreAudio and re-enumerates every device on each pointer event
evidence: LockScreenCard.swift:713-719 SystemVolume.set per onChanged; the volume listener calls systemAudioChanged -> refresh -> AudioOutputs.available() + current() + volume (AudioOutputs.swift:258, 288-307).
fix: Coalesce writes to about 30 Hz; on a volume-property change re-read volume only.

title: Play/pause and heart .symbolEffect(.replace) may cut instead of replace because the state change is not animated
evidence: MediaPane.swift:426-431 contentTransition on media.isPlaying; controls HStack animates canSkip and modes only (:460-462); LockScreenCard.swift:848 heart likewise.
fix: Check live; if it cuts, add .animation(Theme.contentAnimation, value: media.isPlaying) on the glyph.

title: Synthetic-notch recheck runs only at launch
evidence: verifySyntheticNotch called only from install() (NotchController.swift:130, :379-391); NotchGeometry.decide (:109-117) believes a zero safe area when the display frame changed; the 2 s watchdog checks frames, not the notch.
fix: Re-arm verifySyntheticNotch at the end of every build().

title: About Isla is ordered front without activating the app
evidence: SettingsPane.swift:536 NSApp.orderFrontStandardAboutPanel(nil) with no activate; ShelfSharing.swift:26 activates for exactly this reason.
fix: Activate and hand activation back as ShelfSharing does.

title: AirDrop unavailability is a system beep only
evidence: ShelfSharing.swift:51-54 beeps when the service is nil or canPerform is false; didFailToShareItems only restores activation.
fix: One inline Shelf notice saying why.

title: With Save Clipboard Screenshots on, a copy carrying both text and an image (spreadsheet cells, rich text) is saved as an image and its text never reaches history
evidence: ClipboardStore.swift:198-210 checks wantsImages() and .png/.tiff before the text path and returns.
fix: Prefer text when a string flavour is present alongside an image.

title: Lyric credits render bold although the comment says never bold
evidence: LyricRow.swift:113-118 comment 'Never swept, never bold' but .islandFont(fontSize, weight: weight) passes the caller's weight.
fix: Use .regular or .medium for credits.

title: Tertiary text sits under 4.5:1 on chip and hover fills
evidence: Theme.tertiary is 4.58:1 over black only; computed about 4.29:1 on surface, 3.52:1 on surfaceHover (SettingsPane.swift:828, 870-877; ShelfPane.swift:158; ClipboardPane.swift:68). Contrast tests use black only.
fix: Use secondary on fills or test tokens against surface and hover fills.

title: Output picker marks the selected device with a white glyph on the accent colour
evidence: LockScreenCard.swift:575-583 per auditor; white on Yellow accent about 1.4:1.
fix: Add a checkmark and use a dark glyph on light accents.

title: Idle wake-up figure does not reconcile with the timers that run while the display is awake
evidence: Repeating timers while idle and awake: PointerWatcher 8 Hz, ClipboardStore 2 Hz, geometry watchdog 0.5 Hz, feed watchdog 0.25 Hz, helper heartbeat 0.2 Hz (about 11 per second), versus a recorded 0.33 per second averaged over uptime; checklist.md:210-212 CPU gate open.
fix: Re-measure with powermetrics, display on, 5 minutes idle; record beside the CPU number.

title: Smaller Reduce Motion gaps: cover morph and shell still travel (only faster), lock card and stage cut instead of fade, skeleton reads the setting once
evidence: Theme.open(reduceMotion:) only shortens the spring (Theme.swift:126-128) while matchedGeometry cover morph stays (NotchContentView.swift:735, MediaPane.swift:272); .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : ...) at LockScreenCard.swift:234 and others; Skeleton.swift:28-36 checks in onAppear only.
fix: Drop morph ids under Reduce Motion; use a short opacity fade instead of nil; onChange(reduceMotion) in SkeletonBox.

title: With nothing playing, the compact island is hidden from accessibility, so VoiceOver cannot find or open Isla
evidence: NotchContentView.swift:572-583 sets .accessibilityHidden(!shown) on the only element that carries the open action; a11y/pill/idle-resting-in-notch__dark.txt, locked-nothing-playing and synthetic-notch-idle dumps contain only the bare 700x84 hosting view
fix: Keep an always-present AXButton 'Isla' sized to the real notch/pill frame, value describing the state, press action opening the panel; hide only the decorative wing content when folded.

title: Settings switches always draw in AppKit's inactive style: on/off by knob side only, no accent, no Increase Contrast change
evidence: panel-settings/viewport-top__dark.png (Show Charging on vs Launch at Login off differ only by knob side and a slightly lighter track); viewport-top__increase-contrast; dump frames 36x16; visual-lab finding 9
fix: Draw an explicit on-state (accent or white-filled track) independent of key status, with an outlined track under Increase Contrast; pair with owner decision 2 (row-wide target).

title: Settings shows a 162 pt window onto about 700+ pt of rows with no cue that more exists; Quit, the app's only exit, is the last row
evidence: panel-settings/viewport-top__dark.png ends on a clean card edge after five rows; a11y dump scroll area 488x162 with content past y=700; Quit at SettingsPane.swift:602; WelcomePane comment notes an LSUIElement app is absent from Force Quit
fix: Bottom fade mask plus a flashed overlay scroller on first entry; move Privacy higher; consider a pinned Quit/About footer.

title: Privacy cover switches are titled only 'Clipboard' and 'Translate' (ru 'Буфер', 'Перевод'), directly under 'Clipboard History', with no note
evidence: SettingsPane.swift:511-517 uses privacySection.title for the toggle title with no noteRow; ru.lproj 'Clipboard' = 'Буфер'; panel-settings/all-sections-defaults__dark.png PRIVACY card
fix: 'Cover Clipboard Rows' / 'Cover Translate Text' with a one-line note, and a note under Hide from Screen Recording on what it hides.

title: Translate's target language defaults to Russian for every user regardless of system language
evidence: Translator.swift:128 target = stored ?? .russian; alternative(to:) flips only between English and Russian (:231); a11y/panel-translate/empty__dark.txt 'Translate To' = Russian
fix: Default the target to appLanguage or the first preferred language that is supported, falling back to English when the source matches.

title: Large Translate output breaks Russian words mid-word ('железнодорожна' / 'я станция?')
evidence: panel-translate/result__dark.png, result__ru.png, result__increase-contrast.png
fix: Choose the size tier by the longest word as well as the total length, or allow minimumScaleFactor before a character-level break; add a long-Cyrillic-word fixture.

title: Translate remedies ('Turn On Translate Online', 'Retry', 'Translation Languages…') are bare bold caption text, not buttons
evidence: panel-translate/needs-online__dark.png, offline-error, missing-language-pack, apple-intelligence-off; visual-lab finding 7
fix: Use the shared capsule style. For Turn On Translate Online, say in the sentence that the text leaves the Mac.

title: Lyric miss copy is jargon and inconsistent: with online off by default, a new user sees 'No local lyrics.' on nearly every song; four different miss strings; the caption and lock card offer no action
evidence: LyricsPresentation.swift:18-36 maps .noLocalLyrics to 'No local lyrics.' (online off), 'No lyrics found.', invalid file to 'No lyrics for this track.', disabled to 'Lyrics are off.'; lock-card-states no-lyrics-found and lyrics-off tiles show dim status lines with no action; ru 'Текст песен выключен.' is ungrammatical (ru.lproj:178); visual-lab finding 11
fix: One vocabulary ('No lyrics for this song'), with an actionable 'Look Up Online' or 'Turn On' on the caption and lock card, or a one-time ask. Fix the ru string to 'Текст песни выключен.'

title: Decorative SF Symbols are exposed to VoiceOver with system names ('Audiobook', 'Flash', 'Click Cursor', 'Download Multiple', 'Paste'), and empty states consist only of them
evidence: a11y/panel-settings/viewport-top__dark.txt: every row has an AXImage label before its toggle; a11y/panel-shelf/empty__dark.txt 'Download Multiple'; a11y/panel-clipboard/empty__dark.txt 'Paste'
fix: accessibilityHidden on row icons and decorative glyphs; give empty states a real localized sentence (with F-036).

title: With the lock card's output picker open, the scrubber, transport and volume underneath stay in VoiceOver order, interleaved with picker rows
evidence: a11y/lock-card/glass-standard-output__dark.txt: Playback Position sits between MacBook Pro Speakers and AirPods Pro; Previous Track between Studio Display and Living Room; plus two unlabelled 690x690 and 460x300 images
fix: Treat the picker as modal (accessibilityHidden on siblings while open, or an isModal container) and hide the cover-light and grain images.

title: An instrumental break shows a blank stage row that VoiceOver exposes as a selected, unlabelled button
evidence: panel-lyrics-stage/instrumental-gap__dark.png; a11y/panel-lyrics-stage/instrumental-gap__dark.txt AXButton with help only, selected, 444x14; visual-lab finding 6
fix: Draw a breathing-dots or progress glyph on empty current rows and label them 'Instrumental'.

title: Panel close fades the body on an ease-in 0.12 s, so the clip slices still-opaque rail and text; close does not mirror the open choreography
evidence: Theme.swift:70 paneOut = .easeIn(duration: 0.12) vs paneIn easeOut 0.20 +40 ms; contact-sheets/keyframes-close.png t033-t050 show the time label and rail cut while bright; visual-lab finding 3
fix: pane-out as ease-out about 0.09 s, with the body under 40% opacity before the clip has moved 8 pt, or the shape delayed about 30 ms; scale 0.97 to mirror the open.

title: Pill fold (0.50 s, settle 529 ms) is slower than unfold (0.42 s) and outlasts its content by about 300 ms
evidence: visual-lab README curve table: pill fold 0.50 s / 529 ms, unfold 0.42 s / 444 ms, content-out 0.22 s / 233 ms; keyframes-pill-fold t120-t300
fix: Fold response about 0.32 s and content-out about 0.16 s so both finish within about 100 ms of each other.

title: Music-pane caption line turn blurs old and new lines over each other for about 120 ms per line
evidence: contact-sheets/keyframes-caption-line-turn.png t083-t200 (smeared, overlapping); LyricLineTurn on lyricScroll 0.42 s (90% at 216 ms)

title: With cards selected, the Shelf footer reads '2 selected · Deselect · Clear', but Clear empties the whole shelf
evidence: ShelfPane.swift:93-110 ConfirmTextButton Clear -> shelf.clear() shown beside the selection count; panel-shelf/two-selected__dark.png; Clear hit frame 27x13 in the dump

title: Clipboard copy confirmation is only a green tint on the row's 12 pt kind glyph
evidence: panel-clipboard/row-just-copied__dark.png vs populated__dark.png (only the first row glyph turns green)
fix: Swap the glyph to a checkmark for about 1.2 s, optionally with a 'Copied' word, and announce it (F-013).

title: Lists clip their last row hard with no edge fade or scroll cue (Clipboard 5 of 6 rows, Shelf at the cap, stage neighbours)
evidence: panel-clipboard/populated__dark.png row 5 cut square against 'Clear'; panel-shelf/at-the-60-cap__w480.png; panel-lyrics-stage/long-lines-wrapping__w480.png (lab #5)

title: After ⌃⌥⌘T there is no key that copies the translation; ⌘C copies the source
evidence: NotchPanel.swift:103-115 routes ⌘C to the first responder (the source editor); no keyboardShortcut anywhere in panes except LocalLyricsEditorView; Copy is a 22x22 icon (a11y/panel-translate/privacy-covered-input__dark.txt)
fix: ⌘⇧C or ⌘Return copies the output (optionally closing), with the key hint shown on the button.

title: Lock card truncates every lyric row to one line, including the sung line, while the stage wraps two
evidence: lock-card-states/lyrics-long-lines__dark-ir.png ('…past the point wh…') vs panel-lyrics-stage/long-lines-wrapping__dark.png
