title: Welcome pane: Music rail chip lit over a non-Music pane, 'Click it to open' reads as already satisfied, and the four features and the translate key are never named
evidence: panel-welcome/first-run__dark.png; a11y dump shows Music selected; NotchContentView.swift:462-469 blanks the header because vm.tab is left on Music but the rail still highlights it; WelcomePane.swift lists only open and lyrics keys
fix: Select no tab while welcoming; one line per tab with its glyph; 'No Dock or menu-bar icon: click the notch or press ⌃⌥⌘I to come back'.

title: Each Translate language picker is exposed as two AXMenuButtons (label and 7x4 chevron)
evidence: a11y/panel-translate/empty__dark.txt lines 4-8: 'Translate From' twice, 'Translate To' twice
fix: Combine label and chevron into one accessibility element.

title: Refusal shake drives its sine phase through ease-out progress, so frequency halves over the shake and the first frame jumps about 9 pt
evidence: RefusalShake.swift:32 withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.50)), :53 sin(progress * 2π * shakes); animation/refusal-shake-offset.csv 8.8 pt at 16 ms
fix: Fix together with F-018: keyframeAnimator with equal-spaced offsets, or linear phase with a separate decaying envelope ramped in over about 30 ms.

title: Playback Position and Volume surface as AXUnknown with no value in the dump although the code declares value and adjustable action
evidence: MediaPane.swift:368-385 and LockScreenCard.swift:663-734 declare accessibilityValue/AdjustableAction; a11y/panel-music/playing-lyrics-caption__dark.txt shows [AXUnknown] label only
fix: Check live; if confirmed, use accessibilityRepresentation { Slider(...) } so AppKit vends AXSlider with value.

title: Settings slider values have no units ('560', '0') and section titles are plain static text, not headings
evidence: a11y/panel-settings/viewport-top__dark.txt AXSlider Panel Width value=560, Lyric Delay value=0; GENERAL/MUSIC/PRIVACY as AXStaticText
fix: accessibilityValue with units; .isHeader on section titles.

title: Shelf card names keep about 5 characters each side, so similar files are indistinguishable
evidence: panel-shelf/two-selected__dark.png 'Scree….44.png', 'Meeti…otes.txt'
fix: Two-line names, or truncate before the extension and keep the distinguishing tail; full name on hover.

title: Clipboard privacy cover still shows the item count and per-row kind glyph (link vs text)
evidence: panel-clipboard/privacy-covered__dark.png (header '6', link glyph on row 5)
fix: Neutral glyph and hidden count while covered.

title: Russian copy drift: 'пт' for points reads as Friday, 'Вывод' alone for Output, three names for the clipboard
evidence: ru.lproj:196 '%d pt' = '%d пт'; :181 'Output' = 'Вывод'; :7 'Clipboard' = 'Буфер' vs 'буфера обмена' elsewhere
fix: Keep 'pt' or drop the unit; 'Вывод звука'; a short ru glossary.

title: Panel close and tab swap use an ease-in exit that ends at peak speed; re-open mid-close restarts the fade from zero
evidence: metrics.json pane-out handOff; Theme.swift:70
fix: Covered by the H-012 fix (ease-out exit).

title: Screen-capture pickup never matches still screenshots on a non-English Mac
evidence: RecordingPickup.swift:95-101 accepts a still image only when its name starts with a capture prefix. RecordingPickup.swift:116-118 looks up the localized prefix with Bundle(identifier: "com.apple.ScreenCaptureKit").localizedString(forKey: "Screenshot"). I read ScreenCaptureKit's Localizable.loctable on this Mac: it has 43 languages and no key containing 'creen'. The lookup therefore returns the key 'Screenshot', which is already in the list, so no localized prefix is ever added.
fix: Read the word from screencaptureui.app's table, or test the kMDItemIsScreenCapture / com.apple.metadata:kMDItemIsScreenCapture xattr instead of a name prefix (this also settles owner decision 13).

title: One standard LRC tag, one section label or one angle bracket rejects a whole lyric file, and an LRCLIB answer that fails this way is cached as a 14-day miss
evidence: LocalLyricsDocument.swift:60-87 recognises only ti/ar/al/ve/length/offset. Any other bracketed line goes to parseTimedLine (:140-146), where parseTimestamp fails. Because the raw text contains ':', it throws invalidTimestamp and aborts parse(). Affected lines include [by:x], [re:x], [au:x], [#:comment], [id:x], [tool:x] and '[00:12.00][Verse 1: Drake]'. parseWords (:167-176) runs whenever the content has '<' or '>', and throws unless the content starts with '<', so a line like 'I <3 you' or 'a -> b' rejects the file. Local files then become .malformed (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:276-277). For LRCLIB, OnlineLyrics.swift:97-100 and :227 use try? and turn the failure into .none, which OnlineLyricsCache.remember stores as searched miss for missLifetime (:343-344, 14 days).
fix: Treat any [word:value] header whose key is not numeric as metadata and skip it. Keep a non-timestamp bracket after a stamp as text. Parse word stamps only when the content starts with '<mm:ss'. Do not cache a parse failure as a miss.

title: On the AppleScript fallback route, shuffle, repeat, precision sync, Spotify broadcasts, the heart and per-player lyric keying all switch off
evidence: displayedPlayerPID is assigned only in apply() (MediaController.swift:1427) and clear() (:1726). refreshFromPlayers (:1831-1861) sets activeApp and the track but never the pid. displayedPlayerApp (:600-603) is derived only from the pid, so it is nil on this route. As a result, refreshPlaybackModes nils shuffle and repeat (:531-535), precisionPlayer is nil (:591-595), receiveSpotifyBroadcast returns early (:416), requestSpotifyTrackID never runs (:624) so there is no heart, and lyricPlayerID falls back to 'other' (:608-610). In the same code, artworkKey is set before the Spotify CDN fetch (:1853-1856), so a failed fetch is never retried for that track.
fix: Derive the displayed scriptable app from activeApp when feedAvailable is false. Alternatively, resolve the player's pid from NSRunningApplication in refreshFromPlayers.

title: A binding whose LRC has gone leaves the track on 'No lyrics for this track.', never asks LRCLIB, and hides Remove Local Binding
evidence: removeFolder (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:197-206) and rescanFolders (:284-286) drop documents but never prune state.bindings. reloadImportedRecords (:489-499) does the same for missing imports. lookup() returns .invalid(.unreadable) for a binding with no record (:301-304). The online path runs only on .noMatch (LyricsCoordinator.swift:292). hasLocalOverride is set only by an import or select in the current session and is reset on every reconcile (LyricsCoordinator.swift:266). The trash button is gated on it (LyricsStage.swift:511), so after a track change or a relaunch even a healthy binding cannot be removed from the page.
fix: Prune bindings whose id has no record, or treat a dangling binding as .noMatch. Derive hasLocalOverride from the persisted binding on every resolve.

title: A Spotify listener gets the Automation prompt at launch and with the panel closed, and the script and a Web API call run for every track even with nothing consuming them
evidence: apply() calls requestSpotifyTrackID on every track or player change (MediaController.swift:1430-1433). Its only guard is displayedPlayerIsSpotify (:587-589, :624), with no isActive check, no lyrics switch and no account check. It runs PlayerBridge.spotifyTrackID, an AppleScript to Spotify (PlayerBridge.swift:80-88). When connected, it then calls GET /v1/tracks/{id} (MediaController.swift:631, SpotifyAccount.swift:464-486). The resulting spotifyISRC and spotifyExactDuration have no reader outside MediaController (grep). checklist.md:32-37 records that macOS asks 'the first time the panel opens on Music or Spotify' and that 'Nothing is requested at launch'.
fix: Gate the id lookup on an open panel or the lock card, and on lyrics-on or account-connected. Drop the unused catalogue lookup.

title: With Caps Lock on, Command-A/X/C/V/Z do nothing in the Translate field
evidence: NotchPanel.swift:103-105 masks the event flags with .deviceIndependentFlagsMask, which includes .capsLock, then requires flags.subtracting(.shift) == .command exactly. [.command, .capsLock] fails that test, the event falls to super.sendEvent, and an accessory app has no Edit menu to handle it (comment at :54-58).
fix: Intersect with [.command, .control, .option, .shift] before comparing.

title: Lyric files in legacy encodings or common timestamp dialects are rejected, and Import / Add Folder / Rescan errors are discarded
evidence: Every read is String(contentsOf:encoding: .utf8) (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:164, 269, 409, 492). Windows-1251, UTF-16 and GBK files therefore throw, and the scan files them as .unreadable with no fallback (:278-279). parseTimestamp splits on the first ':' and needs Double(rest) (LocalLyricsDocument.swift:200-209), so [00:12,34] and [00:12:34] both throw and reject the file. NotchViewModel.swift:403, 412 and 420 call importLocalFile, addFolder and rescanFolders with try?. importLocalFile also returns silently when currentIdentity is nil (LyricsCoordinator.swift:195).
fix: Try UTF-8 first, then detect the encoding with NSString's usedEncoding or a cp1251/UTF-16 fallback. Accept ',' and ':' as the fraction separator. Surface import errors as one section-level message.

title: The media helper aborts on uncaught Objective-C exceptions where it was meant to degrade
evidence: emitPayload calls [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:...error:NULL] and then checks `if (!json) return` (helper.m:91). Apple documents that this method raises, rather than returning nil, for invalid input such as NaN or Infinity. Duration, elapsed and rate are copied raw from MediaRemote (helper.m:260-262). activePlayerPath calls performSelector with no respondsToSelector check (helper.m:356-359). There is no @try anywhere in the file. Each abort costs one failure, and three failures move the route to fallback with the generic 'kept stopping' text.
fix: Replace non-finite numbers with 0 before serialising, or check isValidJSONObject first. Guard the selectors with respondsToSelector and emit the routeClosed error line instead.

title: A helper that stays alive but only reports empty or undecodable records counts as healthy, and a retry gives up the working fallback on its first empty record
evidence: helper.m:244-262 fills a record with '' or 0 when keys are missing, which is what a MediaRemote that refuses perl answers. NowPlayingFeed.consume refreshes lastLineAt on any byte (:428) and silently drops lines that do not decode (:441-462), so neither the watchdog nor the failure policy notices. feedDelivered (MediaController.swift:1819-1829) removes the fallback observers and sets feedAvailable before it looks at the snapshot. On the fallback displayedPlayerApp is nil (G-003), so admission returns .accept for an empty record (:1072-1074) and apply() clears the island (:1363).
fix: Treat 'helper alive and no non-empty record for N seconds while a scriptable player reports playing' as a route failure. Hand over from the fallback only on a non-empty snapshot.

title: A revoked or dead Spotify grant is never detected, and sign-in failures are silent
evidence: tokenRequest returns nil for any status other than 200 (SpotifyAccount.swift:258-266). freshAccessToken returns nil but never clears the tokens or isConnected (:310-332). refreshSavedState has no 401 branch and retries with the same token (:368-380). toggleSaved rolls back silently (:415-417). Settings reads only isConnected and apiBlocked, never tokenUnavailable (SettingsPane.swift:470-492). The expiry is a wall-clock stamp (:270, :317-318). handleCallback returns silently without a code (error=access_denied), with no verifier after a relaunch, or when the exchange fails (:201-218, :241).
fix: On invalid_grant or a 401 after a refresh, clear the tokens and show 'Reconnect Spotify' in Settings. On a 401, refresh once. Report denied and failed sign-ins in Settings.

title: Copies made while the Mac is locked are recorded at unlock, against the code's stated intent
evidence: NotchController.swift:241-247 suspends the poll on lock because 'Universal Clipboard arrivals from a phone are not something to record behind a shield'. Unlock and wake call resumeFromIdleScreen, then refreshClipboardPolling() with settingChanged false, then clipboard.start() (NotchStores.swift:146-148, 196-198). start() deliberately keeps the old lastChangeCount (ClipboardStore.swift:113-118), so the first poll after unlock records whatever arrived during the lock. Only startFresh() re-baselines.
fix: Re-baseline (startFresh) on the unlock path while keeping start() for display wake, or record the change count at lock time.

title: In the Edit Lyrics sheet, text buttons are forced into circle frames and the sheet may fold with the panel
evidence: NotchButtonStyle frames its label at width = height = size, with a Circle background and contentShape (Theme.swift:464-479). The sheet uses it for Cancel (24x24), Export LRC (76) and Save Copy (a filled 72x72 circle at title size) (LocalLyricsEditorView.swift:97-111). The sheet's minHeight is 340 pt (:116) against a 208 pt body. pointer.isDragging counts drags and menus but not sheets (NotchController.swift:948-950).
fix: Use a text button style for the sheet row. Hold the panel open while a sheet is attached.

title: Import LRC binds the file to whatever song is playing when the open panel returns
evidence: chooseLocalLyricsFile runs panel.runModal() and only then calls importLocalFile (NotchViewModel.swift:397-404). That reads currentIdentity at that moment (LyricsCoordinator.swift:194-198) and stores a persisted binding (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:179). Nothing captures the identity when Import is pressed.
fix: Capture the identity when Import is pressed and pass it through.

title: Translate detection is decided by a single character from another script
evidence: language(of:) runs byLetters, then byScript, before the recognizer (TranslationLanguage.swift:90-93). byScript returns on any kana, Hangul, Han, Arabic or Devanagari scalar in the first 400 characters (:138-156). byLetters returns Kazakh on any of 'әөүұңһ' (:124-131). The detected source then picks the engine. Kazakh and Uzbek are online-only, so with Translate Online on the text goes to MyMemory.
fix: Weigh scripts by share of letters (for example, more than 30%) rather than by presence. Let the recognizer decide mixed text.

title: A panel pinned open by an assistive-tech action has no accessible way to close
evidence: The compact island's accessibility action opens the panel pinned (NotchContentView.swift:580, NotchViewModel pin rule). The header close strip is a bare .onTapGesture with no button trait or action (NotchContentView.swift:497-498). There is no accessibilityAction(.escape) anywhere in Sources (grep). The pin ends only on a real left or right mouse-down in another app (NotchController.swift:737-745).
fix: Add .accessibilityAction(.escape) on the panel root and give the header strip a 'Close' button trait and label.

title: Online requests use URLSession.shared's disk cache and cookie store, so translated text and listening queries may persist on disk
evidence: OnlineTranslation.swift:46-66 sends the user's text as the q query item of a GET over URLSession.shared. LRCLIB (OnlineLyrics.swift:119-130), Spotify and the update check use the same shared session. There is no .ephemeral configuration, urlCache = nil or httpShouldHandleCookies anywhere in Sources (grep). The shared session's default URLCache stores cacheable GET responses, keyed by full URL, in ~/Library/Caches/com.ctimothe.isla.
fix: Use one ephemeral URLSession with no cache and no cookies for every third-party request.

title: Now Playing titles lose ZWJ, ZWNJ, soft hyphens and tag characters
evidence: NowPlayingPayloadDecoder.swift:59-64 strips CharacterSet.controlCharacters, which Apple defines as Cc plus Cf. That removes U+200D, U+200C, U+00AD and U+E0000-E007F, in addition to the intended bidi controls.
fix: Strip Cc and the bidi list only, and keep the joiners.

title: Word-timed LRC rebuilds each line with a space between timed words
evidence: Words are trimmed (LocalLyricsDocument.swift:184), and the line text is words.joined(separator: " ") (:162). serialize writes the same way (:121-123).
fix: Keep the text between markers verbatim, including whitespace, and join with no separator.

title: An LRC with [offset:nan], [offset:inf] or a minutes field of 'inf' or 1e300 parses, then Save Copy or Export traps
evidence: TimeInterval(String) accepts 'nan', 'inf' and huge values. The offset is not range-checked (LocalLyricsDocument.swift:81-86), and minutes have only a >= 0 check (:200-209). serialize then calls Int((offset * 1_000).rounded()) (:114) and Int((max(0, time) * 100).rounded()) (:217), which trap. The editor's save and export both serialize (LocalLyricsEditor.swift).
fix: Reject non-finite values and bound minutes in the parser.

title: The lyrics folder watcher misses subfolders and in-place edits, and is never reinstalled after the folder goes away and comes back
evidence: installFolderWatchers opens one O_EVTONLY descriptor per top-level folder with [.write, .rename, .delete] (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:572-587), so it fires only for entries changed directly in that directory, as the comment at :289 itself says. It is reinstalled only by start, addFolder or removeFolder (:194, 205, 378-382). A folder absent at launch is skipped (:577-578), and a delete or rename only schedules a rescan (:589-596).
fix: Use FSEvents on the folder tree, and reinstall after .delete/.rename and on NSWorkspace didMount.

title: An undecodable local-lyrics index is replaced with an empty one and overwritten with no backup
evidence: loadState returns State() on any decode error (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:624-630). init then rescans and persist() rewrites index.json (:153-160, 614-618). An unknown enum raw value, for example from a newer worktree build sharing Application Support, is enough to trigger it.
fix: Move the unreadable file aside before writing, and decode enums leniently.

title: The screenshot vault never recreates its folder, and two saves in one second can share a name
evidence: The folder is created only once, in init (ScreenshotVault.swift:18-44). write() never calls createDirectory and runs on the concurrent global queue with an unlocked fileExists loop (:115-136). A nil completion is ignored (NotchStores.swift:94-98), and the change count is already consumed.
fix: Run createDirectory before each write on a serial queue, and fall back to recording the text when the save fails.

title: Lock-card volume sets an absolute level on mouse-down, flattens channel balance and ignores mute
evidence: DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0).onChanged calls SystemVolume.set(x/width) on the first event (LockScreenCard.swift:713-720). For devices without a main element, set() writes the same scalar to channels 1 and 2 (SystemVolume.swift:36-45). There is no kAudioDevicePropertyMute read or write.
fix: Use the AudioHardwareService virtual main volume, which preserves balance, reflect mute, and consider committing on drag rather than on press.

title: Get Current Lyric returns a stale line while the panel is closed
evidence: CurrentLyricIntent reads model.media.position (IslaIntents.swift:108-113). The ticker runs only while the panel is open or the lock card is up (MediaController.swift:2057-2070), and the helper dedupes unchanged payloads for 5 s (helper.m:105-112).
fix: Extrapolate from the anchor (the same formula as tick()) inside the intent.

title: A late file promise reopens the panel regardless of lock or sleep, and is lost if the panel is rebuilt
evidence: deliverPromised leads to onDrop, then vm.accept, setOpen(true) and the Shelf tab (NotchRootView.swift:327-335, NotchController.swift:865-873), with no verdictForDeliberateOpen or screensAreAsleep check. The comment at NotchRootView.swift:255-262 expects late stragglers. The receivers and the batch hold the root view weakly, and rebuild() drops it (NotchController.swift:763-795).
fix: Route promise arrivals through the stores, not the view. Add quietly without opening while locked or asleep.

title: Unchanged Translate text is re-translated, and re-sent online, every time the tab reappears
evidence: .task(id: translator.request) runs schedule() on each appearance (TranslatePane.swift:61, 379-391). translate() never compares the input with outputSource (Translator.swift:407-459). OnlineTranslation re-sends every chunk (OnlineTranslation.swift:65-89).
fix: Skip the run when outputSource == trimmed and the route is unchanged.

title: The update check opens any html_url it is given
evidence: Release.html_url is decoded as any URL (UpdateCheck.swift:83-96) and opened by 'Download Isla x' with NSWorkspace.shared.open (SettingsPane.swift:578-580). Only tag_name is validated.
fix: Accept only https://github.com/ctimothe/isla-mac/… and otherwise return .failed.

title: The helper dylib is handed to perl with no identity check, inheriting Isla's environment
evidence: launch() passes the path from Bundle.main.path to /usr/bin/perl -e DynaLoader (NowPlayingFeed.swift:261-276). There is no code-signature or team check, task.environment is never set, and stderr goes to /dev/null. perl does no library validation.
fix: Before launch, check the dylib with SecStaticCodeCheckValidity against the app's own designated requirement, and pass a minimal environment.

title: The clipboard opt-out honours only the three org.nspasteboard markers
evidence: optOut lists ConcealedType, TransientType and AutoGeneratedType only (ClipboardStore.swift:98-102). There is no legacy marker and no source-app exclusion.
fix: Add the legacy marker list that nspasteboard.org documents.

title: The README privacy claim and a code comment are both false about Spotify cover fetches
evidence: PlayerBridge.artwork fetches Spotify's https artwork URL with URLSession.shared, with no setting, on the fallback and held routes (PlayerBridge.swift:230-244; callers at MediaController.swift:1266, 1856). Its comment says 'The one thing the app ever fetches'. README.md:57-66 says nothing leaves the Mac unless it is turned on.
fix: List the cover fetch, which goes to Spotify's CDN with no user data beyond the IP, in the README table, and correct the comment.

title: The Services menu item 'Translate in Isla' is English-only
evidence: NSServices NSMenuItem default is the literal 'Translate in Isla' (Scripts/bundle.sh:69-76). There is no ServicesMenu.strings in Resources/en.lproj or Resources/ru.lproj, and InfoPlist.strings carries only usage descriptions.
fix: Add ServicesMenu.strings for en and ru, and extend test-localizations.sh to cover it.

title: Liked Songs writes race, and a disconnect does not stop an in-flight lookup
evidence: Each heart tap spawns an unserialised Task with an optimistic write and a PUT or DELETE (SpotifyAccount.swift:392-421). refreshSavedState writes saved[trackID] after its await with no generation check (:347-379), even though disconnect() clears saved and bumps credentialGeneration (:290-297).
fix: Serialise writes per track (last tap wins), and check credentialGeneration after each await.

title: A flapping charger re-fires the charging moment on every reconnect
evidence: powerChanged emits an event on every false-to-true external-power edge (AmbientWatch.swift:94-110) with no quiet window. Headphones have repeatQuiet of 30 s (:156-169).
fix: Apply the same quiet window to power.

title: A VoiceOver scrubber step is 5% of the track's length
evidence: Both adjustable actions use step = media.duration * 0.05 (MediaPane.swift:379-386, LockScreenCard.swift:671-678).
fix: Use a fixed step of 10-15 s, or clamp the percentage step.

title: LRCLIB edition stripping mishandles full-width brackets and titles made entirely of brackets
evidence: baseTitle's regex strips only ASCII ( ) [ ] (OnlineLyrics.swift:238-240). Every bracket group is removed, so '(Nice Dream)' becomes '' and bestMatch then returns nil (:209-212).
fix: Add the full-width and CJK bracket pairs, and keep the bracket text when stripping would leave nothing.

title: Switching between the fallback and the helper route re-announces an unchanged song
evidence: The fallback key is 'app|title|artist|album' (PlayerBridge.swift:46), while the helper key is 'pid|title|artist|album' (MediaController.swift:1397). The peek sink fires on any key change (NotchController.swift:1064-1072). LyricsCoordinator re-resolves on a new logicalTrackKey (LyricsCoordinator.swift:243-269). Late fallback replies have no feedAvailable guard (MediaController.swift:1832-1860).
fix: Key logical identity on app plus metadata on both routes, and drop scripted replies once the feed is available.

title: Persisted wall-clock stamps are trusted even when the clock was wrong
evidence: recordings.since is stamped once with Date() (NotchStores.swift:71-74). collect() inserts a name into seen before testing date > since (RecordingPickup.swift:76-83), so captures taken under a future 'since' are rejected permanently. Miss-cache age is Date().timeIntervalSince(checkedAt) with no check for negative values (OnlineLyrics.swift:335). The drop-inbox prune uses a wall-clock cutoff (AppPaths.swift:67).
fix: Clamp future stamps to now when read, and insert into seen only what was actually judged.

title: The karaoke edge runs ahead on truncated lines
evidence: wordFraction is computed over every word in the line (LyricSweep.swift:128-152). KaraokeRenderer maps it onto the width of the runs actually laid out (KaraokeText.swift:28-37). With lineLimit 1 on the lock card or 2 on the stage, the ellipsized runs cover only part of the line.
fix: Base the fraction on the visible characters, or drop the line limit while sweeping.

title: Hot key labels use US key names on Dvorak, AZERTY and QWERTZ layouts
evidence: keyName uses a fixed US table, and any other key shows as '#<code>' (HotKeys.swift:92-98). The comment's premise, that menus show the Latin letter, holds only for non-Latin layouts.
fix: Name keys through UCKeyTranslate with the current ASCII-capable layout. Keep the US names only for non-Latin layouts.

title: A transport tap held during a helper restart is very likely dropped by the new helper
evidence: launch() writes pendingCommand right after task.run() (NowPlayingFeed.swift:316-319). In the helper's constructor, startFeed (which dlopens MediaRemote) and the command reader start together (helper.m:516-524). fgets returns at once with the buffered line, and handleCommand returns silently while sFeedReady is false (helper.m:370-373), which is set only after the dlopen and dlsym calls (:443).
fix: Queue commands in the helper until the feed is ready, or replay from the app on the first snapshot.

title: Clipboard reads have no answer to macOS pasteboard privacy: the change is consumed before any read, a refused or prompted read loses the copy for good, and nothing tells the user
evidence: ClipboardStore.swift:174-176 advances lastChangeCount before reading anything. :181 (data .islaInternal) and :185 (readObjects NSURL) run for every changed pasteboard, before wantsImages (:198) or recordsHistory (:214) are consulted. A nil string returns silently at :215-216. encodeImage treats nil bytes as 'not arrived yet' and retries 12 times at 0.5 s (:262-321). AppDelegate.swift:49-51 hot key reads .string with no cap and no feedback. No accessBehavior, detect* or denial handling exists anywhere in Sources, Scripts or checklist.md (grep). The only record is docs/research/technical-feasibility.md:69 ('not active by default as of macOS 26.4'), and this Mac runs 27.0.1. The Settings note 'Copies are not read or kept' (SettingsPane.swift:508-510) is false whenever Save Clipboard Screenshots keeps the poll alive.
fix: Gate every content read behind types/availableType (not gated). Spend the change count only after a successful read, or retry once after an access decision. On macOS 15.4+ read NSPasteboard.accessBehavior: when it is alwaysDeny, stop polling and show a Clipboard row with a link to Privacy & Security > Paste from Other Apps. Add the state to Diagnostics. Correct the 'not read' note.

title: Every ad-hoc-signed update forfeits Isla's TCC grants (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Automation), contradicting 'the grant sticks'
evidence: Scripts/bundle.sh:207 SIGN_IDENTITY defaults to '-'. checklist.md:614-616 records 0.2.0 as released ad-hoc. TCC keys an ad-hoc binary's grant to its designated requirement, which for ad-hoc code is its cdhash. That changes with every build. RecordingPickup.swift:21-24 and checklist.md:129-131 promise 'one prompt, once ... the grant sticks'.
fix: Ship with Developer ID, which is already the release owner's input and also fixes the Gatekeeper helper block. Until then, state the re-prompt in the release notes and the checklist rather than 'the grant sticks'.

title: On the fallback route Isla sends Apple Events at launch with the panel closed, so the Automation prompt appears unprompted
evidence: switchToScriptingFallback ends with refreshFromPlayers() (MediaController.swift:1790). refreshFromPlayers calls PlayerBridge.currentState (MediaController.swift:1831-1832), which runs an AppleScript against every running player (PlayerBridge.swift:104-121, 66-70). checklist.md:32-37 says macOS asks the first time the panel opens on Music, and that 'Nothing is requested at launch.' This is a different trigger from G-005, which is the Spotify track-id lookup on the helper route, so G-005's fix does not cover it.
fix: On the fallback, read state from the distributed notifications until the panel first opens: Music's playerInfo userInfo carries name, artist, album, total time and state, and Spotify's PlaybackStateChanged carries the same. Send the first Apple Event only after the panel opens on Music.

title: On the fallback route a skip keeps the old song's clock under the new title, and with no 1 Hz correction the lyrics follow the wrong time
evidence: refreshFromPlayers rebuilds the track and calls adopt(state.position) with the default mayRewindAtOnce=false (MediaController.swift:1839-1849). It has no trackChanged branch like apply(). adopt() holds a playing rewind larger than seekThreshold until a second reading corroborates it (REWIND-HELD, :2025-2037). On this route refreshFromPlayers runs only on a player notification or on setActive (:521, :1786). Precision sync is off on the fallback (G-003), so nothing supplies the second reading.
fix: In refreshFromPlayers, treat a changed state.key as a track change: adopt with mayRewindAtOnce: true and clear the rewind candidate, mirroring apply().

title: Play or Pause, Next and Previous act on the session Music Only hides when Isla shows nothing
evidence: PlayPauseIntent is described as 'Toggles playback of whatever Isla is showing' (IslaIntents.swift:179-186). It, NextTrackIntent and PreviousTrackIntent call the controller unconditionally (:188-206). With no track and the feed alive, dispatch sends feed.send(cmd, playerPID: displayedPlayerPID) with a nil pid (MediaController.swift:1004-1012). The helper then falls back to activePlayerPath(), which is whatever owns Now Playing: the film or browser that was filtered (helper.m:361-367). CurrentTrackIntent, by contrast, throws nothingPlaying (IslaIntents.swift:131).
fix: When track is nil, throw IslaIntentError.nothingPlaying from all three transport intents. In dispatch, refuse the feed branch when displayedPlayerPID is nil instead of letting the helper pick the active player.

title: The system media-key fallback is effectively dead: Isla never asks for Accessibility, and every press after the first is swallowed
evidence: The final dispatch branch is PlayerBridge.postMediaKey (MediaController.swift:1016-1017). It posts a CGEvent to cghidEventTap, and its own doc says it 'silently does nothing' without Accessibility (PlayerBridge.swift:204-222). There is no AXIsProcessTrusted call anywhere in Sources. togglePlayPause routes through PlaybackIntent.toggle (MediaController.swift:860-868), which sets inFlight. The only timeout lives in reconcile() (PlaybackIntent.swift:45-80), and reconcile runs only on feed or player reports. This route has neither (no feed, no activeApp), so the next toggle hits `guard inFlight == nil` (PlaybackIntent.swift:34-37) and sends nothing until the panel opens.
fix: Either drop the media-key branch and make the intents throw a visible 'Isla cannot reach a player' error, or bypass PlaybackIntent for the key route (a key is a true toggle) and offer the Accessibility request from a user action, with a Settings row explaining it.

title: Under Music Only, a filtered source that is playing leaves the Music tab saying 'Nothing is playing.', with no pointer to the switch
evidence: emptyState prints 'Nothing is playing.' and adds a line only when fallbackReason is set (MediaPane.swift:594-611). MediaController already publishes otherMediaIsPlaying (MediaController.swift:1114, 1152), but only NotchViewModel reads it, to fold the pill (NotchViewModel.swift:361, 549). The helper emits isMusicApp (helper.m:271-272), and nothing in IslaKit decodes it.
fix: When otherMediaIsPlaying is true, say 'Something is playing that Music Only hides' and offer a button that opens Settings at Music Only. Consider using isMusicApp as an admission signal for unlisted apps.

title: A panel opened with Control-Option-Command-I on the last tab flips to Music as soon as the pointer reaches it
evidence: toggle() opens without selecting a tab, so the panel opens on the last tab. It pins and calls pointer.setInside(true) (NotchController.swift:682-688). With the pointer elsewhere, the watcher drops isInside after closeDelay, and the pin turns that into .standsAsItIs (NotchViewModel.swift:172). The later arrival is a false-to-true crossing, which runs pointerArrived(), and that calls select(.media) unconditionally (NotchViewModel.swift:124-127). OpenOnClickTests.swift:100 asserts 'arriving always lands on Music', but only for a pinned panel already on Music.
fix: On an already-open panel, have the arrival only drop the pin. Keep select(.media) for arrivals that open a collapsed panel. Amend the test deliberately, since the owner set 'arriving lands on Music'.

title: Edit Lyrics' Save Copy binds the edited lyrics to the track playing at save time, not the one being edited
evidence: The sheet's content closure passes binding: currentLocalTrackIdentity() (MediaPane.swift:117-125). That closure re-evaluates whenever MediaPane's body does, which includes every track change. LocalLyricsEditorView's init keeps the @StateObject draft but stores the new binding (LocalLyricsEditorView.swift:16-27), and save() binds with it (:148-151). Nothing in the sheet names the song.
fix: Capture the identity when editing starts (store it in editingCandidate) and show the song's title in the sheet header.

title: Word-timed LRC with an [offset] tag shifts lines but not words, so karaoke runs offset-late, and a negative offset makes Save Copy and Export fail
evidence: parse() subtracts the offset from line stamps only (LocalLyricsDocument.swift:98-102). Words keep their raw stamps (parseWords, :167-188). serialize() adds the offset to both (:117, :122). The draft re-parses its own serialization (LocalLyricsEditor.swift:32), and the word check `timestamp >= lineStart` (:178) throws when words are emitted before their line. LyricSweep compares the position against word.at.
fix: Subtract the offset from word stamps at parse time, and add a round-trip test with a positive and a negative offset on a word-timed file.

title: A watched lyrics folder that is renamed or moved is treated as unreachable for good, because a stale bookmark's resolved URL is thrown away
evidence: resolve() returns URL(fileURLWithPath: folder.path) whenever bookmarkDataIsStale is true, discarding the freshly resolved location (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:558-570). StoredFolder is never refreshed. rescanFolders then keeps the old documents and records an unreadable issue (:236-250). After a relaunch those documents have no records, so their bindings return .invalid(.unreadable) (:301-304, G-004). ShelfStore keeps the resolved URL in the same situation (ShelfStore.swift:143-165).
fix: Use the resolved URL when stale, re-create the bookmark and path, and persist them.

title: Imported and edited lyrics are indexed by absolute path, and any import that cannot be read or parsed at launch is silently removed from the index
evidence: StoredDocument.path is written as destination.path (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:170-175). reloadImportedRecords keeps an import only if String(contentsOfFile: stored.path) and parse() both succeed, and otherwise `continue`s, then rewrites state.documents (:489-499). The next persist() drops it. The file stays in imports/, and its binding becomes .invalid(.unreadable). Folder documents are kept and flagged instead (:236-250).
fix: Store import paths relative to importsDirectory (or rebuild them from the id). Keep unreadable imports in the index with an issue instead of dropping them.

title: The screenshot vault decides what it owns by file name, so it trims and clears the user's own macOS screenshots in ~/Pictures/Isla
evidence: isOwnFile accepts any .png starting 'Screenshot' and any movie starting 'Screen Recording' (ScreenshotVault.swift:142-149). Those are exactly macOS's native capture names. trimToLimit trashes the oldest beyond 200 (:155-173), clear() trashes all of them (:207-215), and usage() counts them (:183-189). The class doc promises 'nothing already in it is touched' (:5-8). Separately, init creates ~/Pictures/Isla at every launch even with the feature off (:18-44, NotchStores.swift:46).
fix: Mark the vault's own files, for example with an extended attribute or a manifest, and trim and clear only marked files. Create the folder lazily on first save.

title: Editing the text of one word-timed line turns off word karaoke for the whole song
evidence: LocalLyricsDraft.document() clears words on an edited line (LocalLyricsEditor.swift:19-28). Document granularity is `lines.allSatisfy { !$0.words.isEmpty }` (LocalLyricsDocument.swift:38-40), and the karaoke gate needs granularity == .word (LyricsPresentation.swift:85).
fix: Make granularity per line (sweep where words exist), or use a majority rule.

title: The lyric editor cannot insert or reorder lines, retimes lines without their words, reports every validation failure as 'This LRC file is invalid.', and drops blank rows silently
evidence: Add Lyric Line appends at last.at + 1 (LocalLyricsEditorView.swift:77-80). There is no move or sort, and parse rejects out-of-order stamps (LocalLyricsDocument.swift:92). The Timestamp field edits only line.at (:56-61). save and export map every error to one string with no row (:148-169). Blank rows serialize as a bare stamp that parse drops as a gap (:160). Rows are ForEach(indices, id: \.self) with $draft.lines[index] bindings and an in-place remove (:55-69), the SwiftUI pattern known to trap on removing a focused row.
fix: Sort on save or offer insert-after. Name the offending row. Move words with their line. Key rows by a stable id.

title: 0.1.0 upgraders keep every LRCLIB lyric cache (*.lrc3.json) forever: the migration deletes only lrc4/lrc5
evidence: v0.1.0 cached LRCLIB answers as <key>.lrc3.json in Application Support/Isla/lyrics (git v0.1.0 LyricsStore.swift:90, :555). The current migration enumerates that same directory as v4Directory (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:156) but removes only .lrc5.json and .lrc4.json (:539-544). No code mentions lrc3 (grep).
fix: Include .lrc3.json in removeLegacyCacheEntries, guarded so it never touches a user .lrc.

title: The translate hot key loads an uncapped clipboard string into the Translate editor on the main thread
evidence: AppDelegate.swift:49-51 reads NSPasteboard.general.string with no size limit. ClipboardStore caps history at 256 KiB (ClipboardStore.swift:256-261), but this path does not. NotchController.translate only trims (NotchController.swift:553-557) and sets translator.input, which a SwiftUI TextEditor renders and the pane measures on every body pass.
fix: Cap the hot-key and Services input like history does, and say when it was cut.

title: The hot keys work invisibly behind the first-run welcome: translated text is never shown, and the lyrics page appears only after Get Started
evidence: The welcome replaces the pane while isShowingWelcome is true (NotchContentView.swift:844-847). select() never clears it; only chooseTab and dismissWelcome do (NotchViewModel.swift:236-257). translate() raises wantsKeyboard with no field mounted and schedules a fold (NotchController.swift:541-574). toggleLyrics sets isShowingLyrics, which dismissWelcome's select(.media) does not reset (tab unchanged).
fix: Have a commanded tab change from a hot key retire the welcome, the same as chooseTab.

title: A known update disappears when a later re-check fails or is merely in flight
evidence: check() sets state = .checking first and assigns the outcome unconditionally, so .failed replaces .available (UpdateCheck.swift:59-78). hasUpdate is true only for .available (:153-156), so the rail dot and the Download row vanish. Any non-200 response, including a 403 rate limit, reads 'Could not reach GitHub'.
fix: Keep the last .available while checking, and on failure unless a newer answer arrives. Tell a rate-limit response apart from a network failure.

title: Open on Hover opens the panel under a button-held drag, such as a window dragged by its title bar
evidence: PointerWatcher.tick samples only NSEvent.mouseLocation (PointerWatcher.swift:201-205). No pressedMouseButtons check exists in Sources (grep). isDragging() covers file drags and menus only (NotchController.swift:948-950). The default openDelay is 0.05 s.
fix: Treat NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons != 0 as 'not hovering' for the open decision.

title: TCC usage strings do not match their callers, and the capture-folder list always adds the Desktop and never prunes
evidence: The Documents and Downloads strings mention only the Shelf (Scripts/bundle.sh:89-92, Resources/*/InfoPlist.strings). The launch scan of a watched lyrics folder under those folders raises the same prompts (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:159). No NSRemovableVolumes, NSNetworkVolumes or NSFileProviderDomain usage strings are declared. captureFolders appends the Desktop unconditionally and writes back an ever-growing list (RecordingPickup.swift:205-218), which is rescanned on every Shelf open.
fix: Word the strings for every caller, add the volume usage keys, add the Desktop only when it is the configured location, and drop folders that no longer exist.

title: Shelf selection keeps cards trimmed past the cap, and Command-click never sets the Shift anchor
evidence: add() trims with items.removeLast without pruning selection (ShelfStore.swift:250-264). select() sets anchor only on a plain click (:327-348), so Command-click then Shift-click toggles one card instead of selecting a range, despite the 'matching Finder' doc.
fix: Intersect selection with items after a trim, and set the anchor on a Command-click.

title: Recording a shortcut that another action owns silently unbinds that action, including 'Open the panel'
evidence: HotKeyCenter.setBinding clears any other action holding the same binding and stores 'none' (HotKeys.swift:249-255). SettingsPane notes only macOS-refused bindings.
fix: Say which action lost its shortcut, or refuse the duplicate with an explanation.

title: Per-track timing nudges belong to the song, not to the lyric file, so binding or editing a better-timed file inherits the old correction
evidence: Nudges are keyed by player, title, artist, album and duration (LyricsStore.swift:265-270, 254-262). importDocument, bind, removeBinding and the editor never touch LyricsStore.
fix: Key the nudge by document id as well as track, or reset it when the bound document changes.

title: A saved edit duplicates its source's tags, so once the binding is gone the song turns ambiguous behind two identical choices
evidence: Save Copy writes a new import with the same [ti]/[ar]/[al]/[length] (LocalLyricsLibrary.swift:168-183). Lookup returns .ambiguous for more than one match (:317-332), which shows the chooser, and candidateLabel uses only title, artist and album (LyricsStage.swift:611-617). Every Save Copy press adds another copy, and none can be removed singly.
fix: Mark copies as edits (label them 'Edited') and prefer the newest owned copy of the same source.

title: Shortcuts and hot keys open a pinned panel on a sleeping display and restart the media clock
evidence: verdictForDeliberateOpen checks only isLockedPresentation (NotchViewModel.swift:496-498). toggle(), toggleLyrics() and translate() never consult screensAreAsleep (NotchController.swift:513-574, 666-695), while build() does (:1105). setOpen(true) calls media.setActive(true) (:1177).
fix: Refuse, or defer to wake, any commanded open while the screens are asleep.

title: On the fallback, a Spotify denied Automation is indistinguishable from 'not playing', so a paused Music track is shown over a playing Spotify
evidence: state(of:) forwards only .loaded and maps .unknown (-1743) to nil (PlayerBridge.swift:66-77). currentState then picks results.first(where: isPlaying) ?? results.first (:104-121). The -1743 code is never surfaced.
fix: Carry .unknown through currentState, prefer no display over a stale paused player, and say in Settings that Spotify access is refused.

title: Lines stay lit through instrumentals and outros: empty LRC gap stamps are dropped and LyricSweep.index has no line end
evidence: LocalLyricsDocument.swift:153-160 drops stamps with no text; LyricSweep.swift:97-105 (index) and :116-120 (end) take only the next line's start. L6: stale highlight p50 23.5 s per track (10.5% of track time), p95 292 s; 214 mid-song lines lit through more than 8 s of silence; 114 outros over 8 s. 764 gap stamps in 231 of 240 tracks are thrown away.
fix: Keep empty stamps as the previous line's end (add an end to LyricsStore.Line) and end the current line there and at the track's end. Optionally decode lyricsfile end_ms. Ending at the stamps alone removes 99.85% of the stale time.

title: The lyric lead does not match the listener: the shipped 0.20 s is about 0.25 s off by the owner's ear, and the model's optimum is 0.30 s on a zero-latency route
evidence: LyricSweep.swift:35,40. L7: at 0.20 s the median onset is +59 ms at 120 Hz with output 0 and only 33% of onsets undetectable; the owner's −0.247 s implies 0.31–0.35 s of unmodelled delay between player and ear. The lead was tuned on 2026-09-21 against the stale published position, but boundary wakes publish a fresh one, so onsets run about 50 ms earlier than that calibration assumed.
fix: Make the lead a sum of named terms: anchor lag, render terms, live CoreAudio output latency, and an acoustic stamp-bias term. Build an acoustic loopback probe before changing the constant.

title: Foundation Timer boundary wakes fire 4 ms late at p50 and 10 ms at p99, up to 17.7 ms under load
evidence: MediaController.swift:264-269 (Timer, tolerance 0, .common, Task hop). L4b: idle p50 4.07, p99 10.0 ms; loaded max 17.73 ms, 1 of 300 later than a 60 Hz frame. A DispatchSourceTimer(.strict) in the same process: p50 0.074, p99 0.29 ms.
fix: Schedule boundary wakes on a DispatchSourceTimer(flags: .strict) on the main queue with zero leeway, and call tick() directly instead of through a Task hop.

title: A playback-rate change without a re-anchor makes the clock jump by hundreds of milliseconds
evidence: MediaController.swift:1541 sets playbackRate before position adoption; the precisionSteers, pending-seek, stale and held branches (about lines 1545-1567) never re-base the anchor. L4a: the next tick jumps −400 to +800 ms and the armed wake is off by −1.10 to +2.11 s.
fix: Re-base the anchor at the current extrapolated position under the old rate before assigning the new rate, for example in playbackRate's willSet.

title: adopt() re-bases the anchor onto the stale published position, leaving the clock up to 50 ms behind
evidence: MediaController.swift:2050-2054 (anchor = (position, nowMono), where position is the last tick's value). L4c: 114 of 300 snapshots re-based; the anchor is behind a perfect player 36% of the time, by a mean of 26.6 ms while behind, at worst 49.9 ms.
fix: Re-base on the extrapolated anchor value (anchor.position + elapsed × rate), not on the last published position.

title: The lock card lights line 1 during the intro while the stage shows nothing and the caption shows it unlit
evidence: LockScreenCard.swift:371 uses centreIndex (0 before the first stamp); LyricRow.swift:135-137 then draws fraction 1 for line timing. L8: all 22,930 cross-surface disagreements are here, p50 9.95 s per track, p95 98.7 s.
fix: Pass isCurrent only when LyricSweep.index is non-nil (or use displayed().swept), so the card draws the opening line unswept, as the caption already does.

title: LRCLIB timelines stamped past the track's duration are accepted unchecked
evidence: OnlineLyrics.swift:88-102 and :209-231 compare durations but never compare stamps with duration. L1: 993 lines in 45 of 240 tracks (18.8%) lie past their own record's duration; L3: 991 of those lines never show. The rest of each of those files is probably timed to a different cut.
fix: Reject or rank down a candidate whose last sung stamp exceeds the duration plus a small tolerance, and try the next search row.

title: A leading UTF-8 BOM drops the first lyric line
evidence: LocalLyricsDocument.swift:57 trims .whitespaces, which does not include U+FEFF, so the line no longer starts with '[' and is skipped. L1: track 36975922 shows 37 of 38 lines; the missing one is the 00:00.00 line.
fix: Strip U+FEFF from the start of the document (or of each line) before parsing.

title: The onset crossfade spring delays the perceived line change by about 104 ms
evidence: LyricRow.swift:164 animates isCurrent on Theme.lyricScroll (Theme.swift:105-108). L7: rise to 10% at 34.7 ms, 50% at 103.9 ms, 90% at 215.8 ms. This is the largest render term in the lead model.
fix: Start the crossfade early by its rise time, or light the onset without the spring.

title: The karaoke sweep animation (0.25 s linear) is mismatched to the 0.1 s position tick and trails the voice by about 175 ms
evidence: KaraokeText.swift:106-108; its comment still says 'one tick'; MediaController.positionTickInterval is 0.1. L5 MODEL: lag p50 175 ms, p95 196 ms.
fix: Drive the fraction from a TimelineView or display link off the anchor rather than animating between publishes, or shorten the animation to the tick and offset the sweep by it.

title: Word ends are never set, and the 50 ms floor makes short words leap
evidence: LocalLyricsDocument.swift:186 sets end nil; LyricSweep.swift:141-146. L5: with end nil, 11,522 of 12,894 synthetic lines deviate more than one character (p50 2.36); with end set, 22. A 10 ms word goes from 0.099 to 0.5 in one step.
fix: Carry word end times where a source has them (lyricsfile words, enhanced-LRC end markers), and interpolate sub-floor words without the jump.

title: LRCLIB lyricsfile (line end_ms and word timing) is never decoded
evidence: OnlineLyrics.swift:32-36 decodes only syncedLyrics, instrumental and duration. L6: lyricsfile end_ms matched 11,901 of 11,901 lines and carries the same line ends as the gap stamps. L5: only 2 real word-timed lines exist in this corpus.
fix: Decode lyricsfile as a secondary source for line ends and word timing.
